mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which lowers borrowing costs and increases consumer and business spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS declines but S&P 500 returns are negative in over 40% of the next 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 4% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises above 4% but S&P 500 returns remain positive in over 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Positive GDP growth combined with increasing housing starts indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If both GDPC1 and HOUST grow but S&P 500 returns are negative in over 30% of the next 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth during an expansion regime signals increased supply and economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO grows but S&P 500 returns are negative in over 40% of the next 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in non-farm payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS grows but S&P 500 returns are negative in over 40% of the next 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases significantly but S&P 500 returns are negative in over 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates combined with low unemployment indicate tight monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is high and UNRATE is low but S&P 500 returns are positive in over 30% of the next 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate during a monetary easing cycle signals lower borrowing costs, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS declines but S&P 500 returns are negative in over 40% of the next 20-day periods.
